artworks.title: An Easthampton Idyll
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a tree-lined path or road leading to buildings in the distance. The viewpoint is from someone standing on the path, with trees on both sides. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage and structures. The trees, leaves, and buildings are detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching. The color scheme is monochromatic, mainly sepia or brown. Near the viewer, tree trunks and shadows add depth, guiding the eye towards distant elements. A signpost on the right suggests human presence.

artworks.title: Helen Burke
artworks.medium: etching in black laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing outdoors. They are positioned slightly to the right of the center with a relaxed posture. The person has short hair, partially covered by a patterned headscarf, and is wearing a garment with a light and dark pattern. The person's facial features are softly defined with a calm expression. They are not holding any objects, and there is no visible jewelry. In the background, there are dense branches filled with leaves and what appear to be fruits.

artworks.title: The Old Mulford Farm
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with buildings, trees, and a rustic setting. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing a detailed view of the surroundings. There is an absence of a distinct horizon line. The image features intricate cross-hatched brushstrokes creating texture and depth, especially in the leaves, roofs, and tree shadows. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of brown and beige, typical of a print. A shadow of the trees extends across the ground towards a barn-like structure in the distance, with an open doorway partially visible, adding depth and a sense of invitation to explore beyond the foreground.

artworks.title: Toledo
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a rustic building on the right side. The structure is detailed with walls, shutters, and balconies. A horizon is visible with additional buildings on the left. Hills are seen in the distance on the left side. There are figures and animals on a path near the building. The color scheme is sepia and brown, giving an aged look. The sky has soft, cloud-like formations created by etching lines.

artworks.title: On the Bridge, Venice
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a bridge over a canal in a historic European city. The bridge skews slightly upward from left to right, with a figure standing on it. Below the bridge, a few gondolas are visible in the water. The architecture above the bridge suggests Gothic influences, with pointed arches and elaborate stonework. The brushstrokes are etched, composed of delicate, closely drawn lines that modulate between light and shadow. The composition is rendered in monochromatic tones, primarily using shades of grey and black.

artworks.title: Waiting Gondolier
artworks.medium: etching in black on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a Venetian canal with a gondola and gondolier. Buildings line the waterway, featuring arched doorways and balconies. The artwork uses sketch-like brushstrokes, creating a textured appearance. The color palette is predominantly black and gray.

artworks.title: Sir Gilbert Scott
artworks.artist: Anna Lea Merritt, after George Richmond
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait drawing of a man from the neck up, showing only the head and shoulders. He faces forward with a serious expression. The man appears to be of mature age, with distinct facial features such as a strong brow and cheekbones. His hair shows signs of thinning on top and he has sideburns. He wears a formal garment with a high collar. The portrait is rendered in a monochrome style, and the background is plain. There are inscriptions at the bottom right of the image.

artworks.title: A Young Republican
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with two figures and an ornate backdrop. The artwork depicts a richly decorated room with Gothic-style windows and elegant architectural details. In the foreground, a table is set with various items, including a teapot and cups. Two figures are seated, one facing directly towards the viewer and the other partially turned away. The background features an intricate wall with patterns and reliefs.

artworks.title: Solitude
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of tall, slender trees from a slightly lower perspective. The horizon is low in the frame, partially obscured by the dense foliage and tree trunks. The trees reach up with delicate leaves creating a lacy effect against the sky. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes resembling a line drawing or etching, enhancing the texture and form of the trees. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, creating a vintage look with varying shades of brown defining the patterns in the landscape. In the distance, there are more trees and shrubs, adding depth to the scene while the foreground paths and clearings are intricately detailed, inviting exploration.

artworks.title: Point Isabel, Florida
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows an etched landscape with rugged terrain, plants, a dirt path, hills with vegetation, a body of water, and a tree line on the horizon. The sky has swirling clouds etched with fine lines. The artwork features intricate lines for texture and depth, creating a contrast between darks of plant life and the lighter sky. The color palette is tan and black.

artworks.title: In the Newark Meadows
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image displays a tranquil landscape with a waterway winding through it. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing the curves of the water. The horizon is high, obscured by dense trees, creating depth. The fine brushstrokes emphasize textures of grass, water, and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and white. Tall grasses and wooden posts line the waterway, enhancing the natural setting. Subtle cloud formations are visible in the background.

artworks.title: The Harbor, Quebec, Canada
artworks.medium: etching in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1927)
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor from a low perspective, looking towards the port. There are buildings along the horizon. There are several ships and boats close to the viewer. The artwork features intricate line work and cross-hatching to depict movement and texture. The color scheme is limited to sepia tones, creating a vintage look. The buildings in the background are subtly portrayed, shifting focus to the ships and water details.

artworks.title: November
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with an old wooden structure, barren trees, grazing sheep, and a small brook. The scene is depicted in a detailed black and gray etching style, featuring cross-hatching for texture and shadow emphasis.

artworks.title: Landscape with Sheep
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with sheep grazing on grass, tended to by a shepherd. A large tree stands in the center, with open land stretching to the horizon. The sky above has textured clouds. The etching uses a monochromatic palette of sepia tones, with detailed cross-hatching for texture.

artworks.title: The Sleeping Shepherd
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic structure with a figure reclining on the right, wearing a hat. In the background, two oxen and a man plowing a field are silhouetted against a gently rising landscape meeting the sky. Fine cross-hatching techniques are used throughout, with a monochromatic color palette of varying shades of gray.

artworks.title: Venice
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed Venetian scene depicted from a low perspective near the waterline. The horizon is low, displaying the grand architecture and bustling activity along the canal. In the background, there is a domed structure and other elegant buildings with towers and statues. The style is intricate with precise line work, suggesting it may be an etching or engraving. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving the scene an antique appearance. A gondola with figures is seen on the water, alongside larger boats docked with people engaged in various activities. On the right, steps lead from the water to a building where more figures are ascending, contributing to the historical ambiance of the image.

artworks.title: Head of a Woman
artworks.medium: monotype in brown and black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1950)
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a person's head and shoulders in profile, facing right. The person has long hair, a defined nose, and a strong chin. The artistic rendering emphasizes shadows on the facial features and hair. The person appears to be wearing a light-colored garment. Surrounding the person are abstract brush-like strokes suggesting a natural setting, possibly trees or foliage, with some elements resembling flowers on the right. The background has a mix of lighter and darker tones, creating a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Tombeau de Marguerite de Bourbon. Église de Brou (Tomb of Marguerite de Bourbon, Church at Brou)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate basilica interior with a tomb. The drawing showcases the tomb of Marguerite de Bourbon located within a grand ecclesiastical structure. The scene includes intricate gothic architectural details, such as pointed arches, ornate carvings, and sculpted figures. The tomb itself is highly decorative, with various figures and motifs carved into its surface. The structure is flanked by pinnacles and finial designs. In the foreground, there is darkened, shadowed floor space. The stonework and delicately drawn decorations suggest a reverence for historical and religious architecture.

artworks.title: Tour aux Archives à Vernon
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a tall, cylindrical tower against the sky. The tower is depicted with detailed stone texture. The color palette is monochromatic with black and grey tones. In the foreground, a group of individuals is near some plants. A large tree is to the left of the tower. In the background, there is an overcast sky with flying birds.

artworks.title: Église St. Sauveur
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This image shows a street-level view of the Eglise St. Sauveur, featuring the intricate details of the Gothic architecture. The church is prominent, with elaborate stone carvings and tall arched windows reaching towards the sky. The focus is on the church facade and surrounding street activity, with detailed line work and a monochromatic color palette of varying shades of gray. People are gathered nearby, some conversing, indicating a busy street scene with makeshift stalls or shelters. Nearby buildings extend into the distance, suggesting a closely built urban environment.

artworks.title: Maison Grande Rue St. Pierre
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate old building with detailed timber framing and stone carvings. The image depicts two adjoining tall, narrow houses with distinct gabled roofs. The facades are highly decorated with intricate woodwork and stone elements. Below, there is a street scene with a small crowd that includes a horse, gathered in front of a shop. The words "Maison Grande Rue St. Pierre" are labeled at the bottom. The drawing captures the architectural details vividly, highlighting the textures and craftsmanship of the buildings.

artworks.title: Cathedral Notre-Dame
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with the Cathédrale Notre-Dame as the central focus. People and boats populate the river, and sailing ships are docked along the riverbank. Historic buildings line the riverbank, displaying various architectural styles. The cathedral's spires tower in the distance, emphasizing verticality. The artwork is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black with fine brushstrokes.

artworks.title: Vue de Caen
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a scenic urban view from a slightly elevated perspective along a narrow waterway. In the forefront, a boat with a tall mast is on the water, flanked by sloping banks leading to rows of old buildings on each side. The densely packed buildings lead to the horizon just above the rooftops, with faint outlines of more structures visible beyond. A spire stands out in the distant skyline against a subtly textured sky. Detailed brushstrokes capture the architecture and flowing water, depicted in varying shades of gray and black for a timeless and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: View of the Pont des Saints-Pères
artworks.medium: etching on simili Japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a river and a bridge. The skyline of a city is faintly visible above the bridge. The brushwork consists of fine lines creating movement and texture. The use of etching or pen creates a black and white look. Trees and foliage are on the right with diagonal strokes. A boat moves along the river on the left. In the distance, buildings and possibly church steeples and a dome suggest an urban landscape. Clouds above cast light on the scene.
